#include<bits/stdc++.h>
#define MAXN 5000010
#define INF 1000000000
using namespace std;

inline int idx(int x, int k, int n) {
    return x + (k - 1) * n;
}

int n, m, k, v1, v2, s, t;
int dist[MAXN];
bool inq[MAXN];

struct Edge {
    int to, nxt, cap, cost;
} edges[MAXN];
int head[MAXN], ecnt = 1;

void add_edge(int from, int to, int cap, int cost) {
    edges[++ecnt] = {to, head[from], cap, cost};
    head[from] = ecnt;
    edges[++ecnt] = {from, head[to], 0, -cost};
    head[to] = ecnt;
}

bool spfa() {
    queue<int> q;
    for (int i = s; i <= t; ++i) dist[i] = INF, inq[i] = false;
    q.push(s); dist[s] = 0; inq[s] = true;
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x = q.front(); q.pop(); inq[x] = false;
        for (int i = head[x]; i; i = edges[i].nxt) {
            int y = edges[i].to, c = edges[i].cost;
            if (dist[y] <= dist[x] + c || !edges[i].cap) continue;
            dist[y] = dist[x] + c;
            if (!inq[y]) { inq[y] = true; q.push(y); }
        }
    }
    return dist[t] != INF;
}

int dfs(int x, int lim) {
    if (x == t) return lim;
    inq[x] = true;
    int flow, res = lim;
    for (int i = head[x]; i; i = edges[i].nxt) {
        int y = edges[i].to, cap = edges[i].cap;
        if (dist[y] != dist[x] + edges[i].cost || !cap || inq[y]) continue;
        flow = dfs(y, min(res, cap));
        if (flow) {
            res -= flow;
            edges[i].cap -= flow;
            edges[i ^ 1].cap += flow;
            if (!res) break;
        }
    }
    return lim - res;
}

int dinic() {
    int flow, sum = 0;
    while (spfa())
        while (flow = dfs(s, INF))
            sum += flow * dist[t];
    return sum;
}

int main() {
    auto read_int = [](int &x) {
        x = 0; char c = getchar(); bool neg = false;
        while (!isdigit(c)) { if (c == '-') neg = true; c = getchar(); }
        while (isdigit(c)) { x = (x << 1) + (x << 3) + (c ^ 48); c = getchar(); }
        if (neg) x = -x;
    };
    read_int(n); read_int(m); read_int(k); read_int(v1); read_int(v2);
    t = idx(n, 110, n) + 1;
    for (int i = 2; i <= 110; ++i) add_edge(idx(1, i, n), t, INF, 0);
    for (int i = 2; i <= n; ++i)
        for (int j = 1; j < 110; ++j)
            add_edge(idx(i, j, n), idx(i, j + 1, n), INF, v1);
    for (int i = 1, x; i <= k; ++i) { read_int(x); add_edge(s, idx(x, 1, n), 1, 0); }
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; ++i) {
        int x, y; read_int(x); read_int(y);
        for (int j = 1; j < 110; ++j)
            for (int l = 1; l <= k; ++l) {
                add_edge(idx(x, j, n), idx(y, j + 1, n), 1, v2 * (2 * l - 1) + v1);
                add_edge(idx(y, j, n), idx(x, j + 1, n), 1, v2 * (2 * l - 1) + v1);
            }
    }
    printf("%d", dinic());
    return 0;
}
